shortDescription: The Reserve Bank of India is likely conducting September USD/INR sell-buy swaps on Wednesday to drain rupee liquidity from the banking system, three traders and two FX brokers said.The dollar-rupee September forward premium rose to 10.75 paise, with forward premiums higher across tenors.
